title: Can Pinnacle Occupational Therapists train parents for home-based therapy?
metaTitle: Home-based Therapy Training by Pinnacle's Occupational Therapists
description: Learn to extend the benefits of occupational therapy to your home environment. Get trained by Pinnacle's specialized occupational therapists to carry out effective home-based therapy for your child.
html: Absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand how important a supportive and consistent home environment is for a child's development. Our expert occupational therapists are well-equipped and happy to guide and train parents for home-based therapy. By collaborating with us, parents can become active participants in their child's therapy journey, building a nurturing space conducive to their child's growth even beyond our therapy centers.
